source_data.model: annual hourly EPW; two adjacent ideal-load zones
source_data.source: Independent annual engine integration example, calendar 2025 with installed official Chicago TMY3 data; weather is not Hong Kong design weather or an actual 2025 historical year.

building.name: Synthetic two-zone annual weather lighting comparison
building.source: Synthetic 40 m2 two-zone annual verification: no windows/people/equipment/ventilation/infiltration, adiabatic floors, always-on lights/constant setpoints, ideal supplied loads; uniform R=2 plus fixed 0.1 m mass layer k=0.5 W/mK, density=800 kg/m3, cp=1000 J/kgK. Not a real building or Hong Kong compliance model.

weather.source: Unmodified Chicago TMY3 EPW bundled with verified official EnergyPlus 25.2.0-cf7368216c Windows archive (archive SHA256 4136901f7e1708f6536d84278e26ad88b414c7efc905febf6d49c2539a36f3cd). https://github.com/NatLabRockies/EnergyPlus/releases/tag/v25.2.0 ; exact EPW bytes are retained as a deterministic gzip example asset with original header/source flags; EnergyPlus distribution notice retained at third_party/licenses/energyplus.txt.

solver.source: Declared numerical QA and process budget for synthetic annual verification; no code or physical tolerance implied.

targets.source: Synthetic constant-thermostat ideal-load target, each heating/cooling zone series <=1 unmet zone-hour annually; not a code criterion or occupied-hours claim.

Zone Ideal Loads Supply Air Total Heating Rate

scope: Full-calendar hourly EPW simulation of two adjacent ideal-load zones; heating/cooling thermal demand and lighting electricity reported separately
assumptions: No windows, people, equipment, ventilation/infiltration; adiabatic floors; always-on lights and constant setpoints
Ideal air loads are supplied thermal demand, not HVAC electricity; no plant/COP or whole-building EUI inferred
Uniform R layer plus source-declared fixed 0.1 m mass layer: conductivity 0.5 W/mK, density 800 kg/m3, specific heat 1000 J/kgK
Weather calendar remapped to declared simulation year; DST/holidays/rain/snow indicators disabled; no design-day/sizing runs
pending: actual building geometry/construction/gain/schedule and meteorological applicability
detailed HVAC, ventilation/moisture, plant electricity and code acceptance
real-project calibration and full engineering acceptance
SQL completion flags disagree with retained successful process/end/log and complete-period evidence; native flags are preserved, not certified true
